observations: Two large circular eye forms, each containing a four-lobed blue shape around a red center, sit side by side against a teal ground, ringed by layered spirals in olive, red, and yellow.

A horizontal orange-framed bar runs across the top, filled with yellow block shapes; a separate orange rectangular frame with a yellow spiral hangs to the left, connected by a chain of orange oval links.
A wide dark-red rectangular mouth zone near the bottom holds a row of white rounded forms outlined in black, with a small purple and dark-red shape centered above it.
reading: The face is built from repeating mechanical units — spiraling rings, lobed wheel shapes, chained ovals — rather than modeled flesh. The flat teal field keeps each element separate and declarative. Where the two circular eye forms face outward with near-identical structure, the effect reads less as a living gaze and more as a display, something mounted or broadcast. The white tooth row below adds a note of bared tension to what might otherwise feel purely playful.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, this work sits between title neighbors #122 and #124. Unlike #122, which layers dense scribbled lines over a volumetric form on black, this work uses flat teal and discrete repeated units. The owned nnotb comparison also places a face structure on the same teal ground.

connections.reason: Title neighbor #122 builds volume through dense overlapping scribble lines on a black ground; #123 replaces that density with flat, discrete repeated units on teal — a direct formal contrast between two adjacent owned works.
The inspected nnotb #174 image shares the same flat teal background, making the ground feel like a consistent choice across two different owned series rather than a neutral default.
